# Winterworks: download and play

`winterworks-0.3.0.jar` in this folder is the whole mod: the winter base, the Cold Zone, the Amber Age and
Hexes & Havoc. It is a **Fabric** mod for **Minecraft Java 1.21.1**.

## Download it from GitHub

Open `mods/winterworks/dist/winterworks-0.3.0.jar` on GitHub and press **Download raw file** (the download arrow
at the top right of the file view).

## Play it with the CurseForge app

1. Open CurseForge, pick **Minecraft**, then **Create Custom Profile**.
2. Name it (say *Winterworks*), set **Game Version** to `1.21.1` and **Modloader** to **Fabric**. Use the newest
   Fabric loader offered; it needs `0.16.14` or newer. Press **Create**.
3. In the new profile press **Add More Content**, search for **Fabric API**, and install it. CurseForge picks the
   build for 1.21.1 (it needs `0.116` or newer).
4. Press the **⋮** (three dots) menu on the profile, then **Open Folder**. Open the `mods` folder inside it and
   drop `winterworks-0.3.0.jar` in. Fabric API's jar is already there.
5. Back in CurseForge, press **Play**. Under **Mods** on the title screen you should see *Winterworks*.

CurseForge brings its own Java 21, so you don't need to install Java.

## Without CurseForge

Install the Fabric loader for 1.21.1 from fabricmc.net, put this jar and Fabric API (1.21.1) in
`.minecraft/mods`, and start the *fabric-loader-1.21.1* profile in the Minecraft launcher. The jar also works on a
Fabric server: put it and Fabric API in the server's `mods` folder. Everyone who joins needs the jar too.

## Where to start

* Every item is in the **Winterworks** creative tab.
* Cold Zone: dig down under snowy biomes for the Ice Caves; frozen tombs hold the Frost Mauler.
* Amber Age: brush suspicious sand and gravel in any cave. Dead Caves lie under badlands, and Dig Sites are
  underground.
* Hexes & Havoc: Hex Fortresses are in the Nether. Give the Piglin Witch an Elixir of Greed before she will trade.
  To try a fortress at once, use `/winterworks hexfortress` (cheats on).
